scope: Focused primary-source search; not an exhaustive survey or new native benchmark

sources.title: Lipschitz Pruning: Hierarchical Simplification of Primitive-Based SDFs
sources.finding: Exact pruning and far-field constants are separate operations. GPU construction uses a spatial hierarchy; partial updates and sparse adaptive structure remain future directions.
sources.cubey_decision: Extend the existing method before treating the current exact-only CPU/64 prototype as its performance ceiling.
sources.scope_limit: Earlier isolated first-level donor qualification is not a full native hierarchy/allocator qualification.

sources.title: Sphere tracing: A geometric method for the antialiased ray tracing of implicit surfaces
sources.inspected: Author institution publication record and abstract; plan supplies its own lower-bound derivation
sources.finding: Distance lower bounds support safe ray advances.
sources.cubey_decision: Audit whether the existing globally safe sampled point bound needs its extra cell-exit clamp.
sources.scope_limit: No new native safety or speed claim follows from the mathematical derivation alone.

sources.title: Accelerating Signed Distance Functions
sources.inspected: Sections 4.1-4.3, 5 and discussion; publication metadata from author page
sources.finding: Cheap proxy nodes and geometry-changing LOD are distinct. Discontinuous proxies have operator-placement restrictions; even continuous field changes can affect a parent blend.
sources.cubey_decision: Keep root traversal bounds first; subtree proxy insertion is a conditional alternative with additional field-value contracts.
sources.scope_limit: No proxy or LOD implementation was imported, run or benchmarked.

sources.title: Sphere Carving: Bounding Volumes for Signed Distance Fields
sources.inspected: Project, paper bounds construction/results/limitations, author-provided release README
sources.finding: Conservative black-box field queries can build tight bounds. Difficult fields and multi-part decomposition may require seconds.
sources.cubey_decision: Conditional tighter-proxy generation after analytic model bounds are measured.
sources.scope_limit: The MIT release explicitly differs from the paper implementation; neither was run in this pass.

sources.title: Segment Tracing Using Local Lipschitz Bounds
sources.inspected: Author project page, publisher paper abstract and source README
sources.finding: Local segment bounds reduce query count without requiring a precomputed spatial cache.
sources.cubey_decision: Conditional iteration-cost experiment after query work is cheaper.
sources.scope_limit: The author release notes that its scenes/timings differ from those in the paper; no port or new benchmark.

sources.title: Enhanced Sphere Tracing
sources.finding: Checked over-relaxation is a possible iteration accelerator; the paper also presents other quality/stopping mechanisms.
sources.cubey_decision: Only the checked stepping idea is a later candidate; keep current exact hit/exhaustion rules.
sources.scope_limit: No assumption that every paper enhancement meets the frozen Cubey surface contract.

sources.title: Massively Parallel Rendering of Complex Closed-Form Implicit Surfaces
sources.inspected: Author overview and paper architecture overview
sources.finding: GPU-friendly hierarchical interval evaluation can cull regions and reduce expression tapes for a broad expression class.
sources.cubey_decision: Broader representation/compiler alternative, not the first primitive-SDF acceleration change.
sources.scope_limit: No backend integration or source/value equivalence qualification.

sources.title: Fidget
sources.inspected: Current repository README/crate layout and author writeup
sources.finding: Expression tapes, simplification and fast native evaluation are available. The project emphasizes CPU evaluation and also contains a WGPU crate.
sources.cubey_decision: Research reference for a future compiler/representation decision.
sources.scope_limit: README calls it experimental; no library/API/version adoption. MPL-2.0 repository metadata observed, not a license-integration assessment.

sources.title: Generalized Lipschitz Tracing of Implicit Surfaces
sources.inspected: Full publisher text: introduction, bound-generation assumptions and limitations
sources.finding: Directional derivative fields can guide original-function tracing. The fast procedural GPU fit is approximate and lacks automatic failure detection/mitigation.
sources.cubey_decision: Defer while the current known-Lipschitz source admits simpler qualified bounds.
sources.scope_limit: No heuristic fit is accepted as a certified replacement for the current contract.

sources.title: Synchronized-tracing of implicit surfaces
sources.inspected: Author preprint abstract and pipeline description
sources.finding: Tile coherence and on-demand blobtree pruning are another rendering architecture.
sources.cubey_decision: Alternative pipeline research if shared 3D acceleration fails the workload.
sources.scope_limit: Preprint; no current-source operator/secondary-ray compatibility or performance qualification.

search_axes: Local CSG reduction and conservative far-field acceleration
Ray and model bounds for empty-space queries
Sphere/segment tracing variants and their safety contracts
GPU hierarchy construction and update limitations
Alternative proxy/expression pipelines with source-quality constraints
